candidate.title: Unbounded HTML table colspan expansion causes denial of service
candidate.message: Confirmed strong DoS candidate: src/convert/altchunk.rs parses attacker HTML td/th colspan directly as usize (lines ~564-568), sums spans into cols (lines ~475-481), then emits one w:gridCol per column using for _ in 0..cols (line ~497), no clamp/budget. A tiny embedded HTML altChunk with colspan=1000000000 forces billions of iterations/output despite DOCX admission. Exact call-path/evidence being checked.
